_seo.title: Streetak: Street Football | Free Online 3v3 & 5v5 Soccer Game
_seo.desc: Free online street football (soccer) game: 3v3 and 5v5 with friends by room code, street skills, 9 courts from Cairo to Diriyah and Dubai, and Egyptian commentary. On Android, iPhone and the web.
_seo.ogTitle: Streetak: Street Football | Football is back on the street
_seo.ogDesc: A free online street football game with your friends: 3v3 and 5v5, street skills and 9 courts. On Android, iPhone and the web.
_seo.imgAlt: Streetak: Street Football, an online football game with friends
_seo.gameDesc: A free online street football (soccer) game, 3v3 and 5v5: one player each and a free ball, street skills (nutmeg, rainbow, roulette, step-over, fake shot, slide tackle), 9 courts (El-Sayeda Zeinab, a Cairo rooftop, an alley, the pyramids, Neon Cairo, a five-a-side cage, orbit, Diriyah and a Dubai marina rooftop), TV-style replays, rooms with friends by code, clubs and cups, and Egyptian commentary. Nothing you can buy makes anyone stronger.

_seo.videoDesc: A tour of the nine Streetak courts and their players: El-Sayeda Zeinab, Diriyah, the Marina Rooftop, the pyramids, the rooftop, the alley, Neon Cairo, orbit and the five-a-side cage.

t.sub: Your crew is on the pitch right now, roasting you for not showing up. Go shut them up.
t.aHero: A Streetak player in a red number 9 shirt holding the ball, with the minarets of old Cairo behind him on the El-Sayeda Zeinab court
t.aCourt: The El-Sayeda Zeinab court in the Streetak football game
t.cK: 9 courts, from the alley to orbit
t.cL: The ground you will win on… or the one you will get embarrassed on, in front of the whole block.
t.s8p: Fresh asphalt on the midan, minarets overhead.
t.s6p: Mud-brick lanes, and the ball bounces high.
t.s7p: Above the towers, on a hard court.
t.s0p: Uncle Hamada's roof, the Citadel watching.
t.s5p: A glossy deck and a drone for a ref.
t.s3p: The ball floats. The shame does not.
t.g1: One player each, and a free ball
t.g1p: Not glued to your feet. Every pass, shot and slide is yours.
t.g2p: After every goal: the build-up, the strike in slow motion, the scorer's celebration.
t.g3p: TV, behind the player or dynamic. Pick the one that suits you.
t.g4p: He lives the match with you and screams your name when you score.
t.aReel: Streetak: the courts and the players
t.sL: The ball is yours… the shame is theirs. Tap a move and hear the Egyptian commentator.
t.m1p: Through his legs, in front of the whole block.
t.m2p: Left… right… and he is still looking for you.
t.m3p: A shot that shakes the net.
t.m4p: The keeper will remember it till the end of the year.
t.m6p: And an Egyptian commentator screaming your name.
t.m5p: Nutmegs, chips, rainbows, spins… all waiting for you on the pitch.
t.kL: Make up to 3 characters in different positions, keeper included. Each with its own face, hair, kit and number.
t.k1p: A striker, a midfielder, a defender… each with his own level and skills.
t.k3p: Face, skin and hair, the way you like.
t.k4p: Hoodies, track tops and kits in your colours and your number.

t.qL: Football without your friends has no taste. A room with a code, 3v3 or five-a-side with a keeper. If someone is missing, bots fill in.
t.f1p: A room with a code. Send it to your friends and the match starts.
t.f2p: Your colours and crest, and cups to enter, including a Ramadan cup.
t.f3p: Talk while you play, no other app needed.
t.x1a: Yes. Streetak is a free football game on Android, iPhone and the web. The shop sells looks only (kits, balls, card frames), and nothing you can buy makes anyone stronger.
t.x2q: Which phones does it run on?
t.x2a: Android phones from Google Play and iPhones from the App Store. If you would rather not download anything, play in the browser at play.streetak.com on a phone or a computer.
t.x3q: Can I play with my friends?
t.x3a: Of course. Make a room, send the code to your friends and play online, 3v3 or 5v5 with a keeper. If someone is missing, bots fill in. You can also start a club with your name and enter cups, including a Ramadan cup.
t.x4a: English and Egyptian Arabic, with an Egyptian commentator who lives the match with you.
t.x5a: Nine: El-Sayeda Zeinab, up on the roof, our alley, by the pyramids, Neon Cairo, the five-a-side cage, in orbit, Diriyah in Saudi Arabia and the Marina Rooftop in the UAE. Every surface changes how the ball runs and how far you slide.
t.x6a: You control one player, and the ball is free, not glued to your feet. You have the street skills: nutmegs, rainbows, roulettes, step-overs, the fake shot and slide tackles. Matches last four minutes.
t.fl: No way. Come show them what you got.
